PyMuPDFb==1.24.1.condition: Required by the split PyMuPDF 1.24.2 binary distribution; deployment must disclose and provision the matching library.

unavailable.svg_png_compatibility: No equivalent renderer verified within declared libraries; do not substitute raster output.
unavailable.office_vector_preview: No headless browser, Office renderer or ImageMagick invocation; preserve original vectors and report visual_validation=not_run.
unavailable.general_shape_boolean: Removed upstream skia-pathops backend; only bounded axis-aligned solid rectangle Boolean is supported.
unavailable.complex_text_shaping: Removed upstream uharfbuzz backend; ordinary native editable text and limited PyMuPDF static-font text-outline remain supported.

pdf_input.license: AGPL-3.0 or commercial license, independently of PPT Master MIT
pdf_input.condition: PDF-source adapter requires deployment license compliance; declaring the package does not add a public PDF command.

missing_behavior: Refuse unavailable selected operation; never auto-install or silently replace geometry or rendering.

limited.text-outline: Explicit authorized single static local TTF/OTF; ASCII and basic CJK single line, editable shape paths not text; no complex shaping, font fallback or kerning.
limited.boolean: Axis-aligned solid rectangles only; no general curve intersections, arbitrary shapes or text Boolean.
